title: WP Rocket Review
description: A documented profile of WP Rocket as a paid page-caching option for WordPress sites not using LiteSpeed server caching.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped WP Rocket WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: Page caching is enabled by default according to the official knowledge base
The cache reduces repeated PHP and database work by serving generated HTML
Cache behavior can be controlled for mobile, logged-in users, and specific URLs
bestFor: Sites on non-LiteSpeed hosting that need a focused paid page-cache option.
researchScope: This profile reviews WP Rocket’s official caching documentation. It does not compare measured speed against other cache plugins.
caveats: Use only one full-page cache plugin. Test exclusions for carts, account pages, memberships, and other dynamic content before launch.
